title: रण की वो रोशनी… जो नाम लेकर बुलाती है 😱 | Chir Batti | Hindi Horror Story
logline: In the Rann of Kutch, ghost lights call people in the voices of the ones they took. A ten-year-old herder's son walks into the salt desert with a brass bell to bring his father home.

characters.name: Kanji
characters.look: thin Indian boy aged 10 from Kutch, short black hair, sun-tanned skin, white frilled kediyu top, white dhoti, a small red cloth tied on his head

characters.name: Raghu Dada
characters.look: Indian herder aged 70 from Kutch, big curled white moustache, white turban, white frilled kediyu, white dhoti, holding a dark wooden walking stick

characters.name: Jeevi
characters.look: Indian woman aged 35 from Kutch, black odhni with small round mirror-work, red embroidered skirt, silver bangles, hair under the odhni

characters.name: Hamir
characters.look: Indian herder aged 40 from Kutch, thick black moustache, white turban, white frilled kediyu, white dhoti, long wooden herder's staff

characters.name: The Light (chir batti)
characters.look: a floating ball of pale blue-white light the size of a lantern, glowing softly, hovering low over the ground, no body, no face

props.look: a dented brass buffalo bell hanging on a braided black cord
a big black Banni buffalo with long curved horns and a braided black cord round its neck

scenes.setting: the Great Rann of Kutch, an endless flat white salt desert, plain unmarked salt crust with natural hexagon cracks, moonless night, black sky full of stars, three pale blue-white lights floating low over the salt

lines.speaker: narrator
lines.text: कच्छ के रण में अगर रात को कोई रोशनी तुम्हारा नाम पुकारे… उसके पीछे मत जाना।
lines.en: In the Rann of Kutch, if a light calls your name at night… don't follow it.

lines.speaker: narrator
lines.text: यहाँ के लोग उसे चिर बत्ती कहते हैं। वो रोशनी जो चलती है।
lines.en: The people here call it chir batti. The light that walks.
lines.shot: three glowing pale blue balls of light drifting over a white salt desert under stars

lines.speaker: narrator
lines.text: कहते हैं, जो उसके पीछे गया, रण ने उसे कभी वापस नहीं किया।
lines.en: They say whoever followed it was never given back by the Rann.

lines.speaker: light
lines.text: कानजी… कानजी… इधर आओ।
lines.en: Kanji… Kanji… come here.

lines.speaker: narrator
lines.text: और उस साल, वो रोशनी एक दस साल के लड़के का नाम ले रही थी।
lines.en: And that year, the light was calling the name of a ten-year-old boy.

scenes.setting: a Maldhari herders' village of round white mud huts with conical thatched roofs in the Banni grasslands of Kutch, Gujarat at sunset, round mud huts, buffaloes grazing on dry grass, a boy standing at the edge looking towards the white horizon

lines.speaker: narrator
lines.text: बन्नी के घास के मैदान। गोल मिट्टी के घर, जिन्हें भूंगा कहते हैं।
lines.en: The grasslands of Banni. Round mud houses called bhungas.

lines.speaker: narrator
lines.text: यहाँ मालधारी रहते हैं। भैंसों के साथ, रण के किनारे।
lines.en: The Maldhari herders live here. With their buffaloes, at the edge of the Rann.

lines.speaker: narrator
lines.text: हर शाम दस साल का कानजी गाँव के आख़िरी घर पर खड़ा होकर रण की तरफ़ देखता था।
lines.en: Every evening, ten-year-old Kanji stood at the last house and stared at the Rann.
lines.shot: a boy in a white frilled top standing alone at the edge of a grassland, white salt horizon beyond

lines.speaker: narrator
lines.text: क्योंकि तीन रात पहले, उसके बापू उसी तरफ़ गए थे… और लौटे नहीं।
lines.en: Because three nights ago, his father had gone that way… and had not come back.

scenes.setting: inside a round mud hut of a Maldhari herders' village of round white mud huts with conical thatched roofs in the Banni grasslands of Kutch, Gujarat at dusk, a worried woman, an old man and a boy sitting by a small fire

lines.speaker: narrator
lines.text: उस रात उनकी सबसे अच्छी भैंस, काली, रस्सी तोड़कर रण की तरफ़ भाग गई थी।
lines.en: That night their best buffalo, Kali, had broken her rope and run towards the Rann.

lines.speaker: narrator
lines.text: हमीर, कानजी के बापू, लाठी उठाकर उसके पीछे गए थे।
lines.en: Hamir, Kanji's father, had picked up his staff and gone after her.

lines.speaker: jeevi
lines.text: तीन दिन हो गए। गाँव वाले कहते हैं, अब ढूँढना बेकार है।
lines.en: It's been three days. The villagers say there's no use searching now.

lines.speaker: kanji
lines.en: Baba is alive, Ma. I know it.

lines.speaker: narrator
lines.text: रघु दादा चुप रहे। उन्होंने बस दरवाज़े की तरफ़ देखा, जहाँ से रण दिखता था।
lines.en: Raghu Dada said nothing. He only looked at the door, through which the Rann could be seen.

scenes.setting: inside the mud hut at night, an old man telling a story by a small fire, a boy listening wide-eyed

lines.speaker: raghu
lines.text: सुन, कानजी। रण में अमावस की रातों को रोशनियाँ चलती हैं।
lines.en: Listen, Kanji. On moonless nights, lights walk in the Rann.

lines.speaker: raghu
lines.text: पहले दूर दिखती हैं। फिर पास आती हैं। फिर किसी का नाम लेती हैं।
lines.en: First they're far away. Then they come closer. Then they call someone's name.

lines.speaker: kanji
lines.text: किसका नाम, दादा?
lines.en: Whose name, Dada?

lines.speaker: raghu
lines.text: जिसे वो ले जाना चाहती हैं। और जिन्हें वो ले जा चुकीं… उनकी आवाज़ में बोलती हैं।
lines.en: Whoever they want to take. And they speak… in the voices of the ones they've already taken.

lines.speaker: narrator
lines.text: आग की लौ काँपी। बाहर, बहुत दूर, रण पर कुछ चमका।
lines.en: The flame flickered. Outside, far away, something glowed on the Rann.
lines.shot: through a round hut's doorway, a tiny blue light glowing far away on a dark white desert

scenes.setting: the edge of a Maldhari herders' village of round white mud huts with conical thatched roofs in the Banni grasslands of Kutch, Gujarat at night facing the Great Rann of Kutch, an endless flat white salt desert, plain unmarked salt crust with natural hexagon cracks, moonless night, black sky full of stars, a boy standing alone, a blue light far out on the salt

lines.speaker: narrator
lines.text: आधी रात को कानजी की नींद खुली। किसी ने बाहर से पुकारा था।
lines.en: At midnight Kanji woke up. Someone had called from outside.

lines.speaker: hamir
lines.text: कानजी… कानजी, बेटा… मैं यहाँ हूँ!
lines.en: Kanji… Kanji, son… I'm here!
lines.shot: a single pale blue light glowing far away on a dark white salt desert, seen from a hut door

lines.speaker: narrator
lines.text: बापू की आवाज़। वही आवाज़, जो हर सुबह उसे जगाती थी।
lines.en: Baba's voice. The same voice that woke him every morning.

lines.speaker: kanji
lines.text: बापू! बापू, मैं आ रहा हूँ!
lines.en: Baba! Baba, I'm coming!
lines.shot: a barefoot boy running from the mud huts towards a glowing blue light on a white desert at night

lines.speaker: narrator
lines.text: वो नंगे पाँव रण की तरफ़ दौड़ा।
lines.en: He ran barefoot towards the Rann.

scenes.setting: the edge of the Great Rann of Kutch, an endless flat white salt desert, plain unmarked salt crust with natural hexagon cracks at night, an old man with a walking stick grabbing a boy by the arm, a blue light ahead

lines.speaker: narrator
lines.text: एक झटके में किसी ने उसका हाथ पकड़ लिया। रघु दादा।
lines.en: In a jerk, someone caught his arm. Raghu Dada.

lines.speaker: raghu
lines.text: रुक जा! वो तेरे बापू नहीं हैं!
lines.en: Stop! That is not your father!

lines.speaker: kanji
lines.text: पर दादा, वो बापू की आवाज़ है!
lines.en: But Dada, that's Baba's voice!

lines.speaker: raghu
lines.text: हाँ। इसीलिए तो डर है।
lines.en: Yes. That's exactly why I'm afraid.

lines.speaker: narrator
lines.text: दूर रोशनी एक पल रुकी। जैसे उसने उन्हें सुन लिया हो। फिर धीरे-धीरे बुझ गई।
lines.en: The far light paused for a moment. As if it had heard them. Then it slowly went out.

scenes.setting: inside the mud hut at dawn, an old man showing a boy a dented brass buffalo bell

lines.speaker: narrator
lines.text: सुबह रघु दादा ने कानजी को अपने पास बिठाया।
lines.en: In the morning, Raghu Dada sat Kanji down beside him.

lines.speaker: raghu
lines.text: एक बात याद रख। वो रोशनी हर आवाज़ की नक़ल कर सकती है। इंसान की, जानवर की।
lines.en: Remember one thing. That light can copy every voice. A man's, an animal's.

lines.speaker: raghu
lines.text: पर पीतल की नहीं। घंटी की आवाज़ असली होती है।
lines.en: But not brass. The sound of a bell is always real.

lines.speaker: narrator
lines.text: उन्होंने एक पुरानी पीतल की घंटी उसके हाथ में रखी।
lines.en: He placed an old brass bell in his hand.
lines.shot: close-up of an old wrinkled hand placing a dented brass bell in a small boy's palm

lines.speaker: raghu
lines.text: काली के गले में भी ऐसी ही घंटी थी। तेरे बापू ने ख़ुद बाँधी थी।
lines.en: Kali wore a bell just like this on her neck. Your father tied it himself.

lines.speaker: kanji
lines.text: तो अगर बापू काली के पास हैं… तो घंटी बजेगी।
lines.en: So if Baba is with Kali… the bell will ring.

scenes.setting: a Maldhari herders' village of round white mud huts with conical thatched roofs in the Banni grasslands of Kutch, Gujarat in afternoon heat, villagers shaking their heads, a woman crying at a hut door

lines.speaker: narrator
lines.text: उस दिन गाँव के आदमी फिर रण में गए। शाम को ख़ाली हाथ लौटे।
lines.en: That day the village men went into the Rann again. They came back empty-handed at dusk.

lines.speaker: jeevi
lines.text: बस अब कोई नहीं जाएगा। रण ने एक ले लिया है। दूसरा नहीं दूँगी।
lines.en: No one else goes now. The Rann has taken one. I won't give it another.

lines.speaker: narrator
lines.text: उसने कानजी को सीने से लगा लिया। पर कानजी की आँखें रण पर थीं।
lines.en: She held Kanji to her chest. But Kanji's eyes were on the Rann.

scenes.setting: the doorway of a mud hut in a Maldhari herders' village of round white mud huts with conical thatched roofs in the Banni grasslands of Kutch, Gujarat at night, a boy slipping out quietly with a brass bell, moonless night, black sky full of stars
scenes.continuity: the boy holds the brass bell in his hand

lines.speaker: narrator
lines.text: दूसरी अमावस की रात। सब सो गए थे।
lines.en: The second moonless night. Everyone was asleep.

lines.speaker: narrator
lines.text: कानजी ने घंटी कपड़े में लपेटी, ताकि आवाज़ न हो, और चुपके से बाहर निकल गया।
lines.en: Kanji wrapped the bell in cloth so it wouldn't ring, and slipped outside.

lines.speaker: narrator
lines.text: सामने रण था। सफ़ेद, ख़ामोश, और अंतहीन।
lines.en: Ahead was the Rann. White, silent and endless.
lines.shot: a small boy from behind, standing at the edge of an endless white salt desert under a starry sky

lines.speaker: kanji
lines.text: बापू, मैं आ रहा हूँ।
lines.en: Baba, I'm coming.

scenes.setting: the Great Rann of Kutch, an endless flat white salt desert, plain unmarked salt crust with natural hexagon cracks, moonless night, black sky full of stars, a small boy walking alone on the cracked white salt, faint blue lights far away
scenes.continuity: the boy holds the brass bell

lines.speaker: narrator
lines.text: रण में अँधेरा भी सफ़ेद होता है। नमक तारों की रोशनी पकड़ लेता है।
lines.en: In the Rann even the dark is white. The salt catches the starlight.

lines.speaker: narrator
lines.text: कानजी चलता गया। गाँव की आख़िरी रोशनी पीछे छूट गई।
lines.en: Kanji kept walking. The village's last light was left behind.

lines.speaker: narrator
lines.text: फिर सामने, दूर, एक नीली रोशनी जली। फिर दूसरी। फिर तीसरी।
lines.en: Then ahead, far away, a blue light glowed. Then a second. Then a third.
lines.shot: three pale blue lights appearing one by one on a dark horizon of white salt

lines.speaker: narrator
lines.text: वो धीरे-धीरे उसकी तरफ़ आने लगीं।
lines.en: Slowly, they began to move towards him.

scenes.setting: the Great Rann of Kutch, an endless flat white salt desert, plain unmarked salt crust with natural hexagon cracks, moonless night, black sky full of stars, blue lights circling a frightened boy on the salt
scenes.continuity: the boy clutches the brass bell

lines.speaker: jeevi
lines.text: कानजी! कानजी, घर आ जा, बेटा! मैं यहाँ हूँ!
lines.en: Kanji! Kanji, come home, son! I'm here!
lines.shot: a pale blue light hovering behind a frightened boy on white salt at night

lines.speaker: narrator
lines.text: माँ की आवाज़। ठीक उसके पीछे से।
lines.en: Ma's voice. Right behind him.

lines.speaker: kanji
lines.text: माँ? पर माँ तो घर पर सो रही है…
lines.en: Ma? But Ma is asleep at home…

lines.speaker: raghu
lines.text: कानजी, इधर आ। रास्ता इधर है।
lines.en: Kanji, come here. The way is here.
lines.shot: a pale blue light floating to the left in the dark over cracked salt

lines.speaker: narrator
lines.text: अब दादा की आवाज़। बाईं तरफ़ से। पर दादा भी तो घर पर थे।
lines.en: Now Dada's voice. From the left. But Dada was at home too.
lines.shot: a boy turning in fear as glowing blue lights circle him on white salt

lines.speaker: narrator
lines.text: कानजी समझ गया। ये वही रोशनियाँ थीं।
lines.en: Kanji understood. These were the lights.

scenes.setting: the Great Rann of Kutch, an endless flat white salt desert, plain unmarked salt crust with natural hexagon cracks, moonless night, black sky full of stars, a man-shaped figure made of pale blue light walking towards a boy, the boy's shadow on the salt but no shadow under the figure

lines.speaker: narrator
lines.text: फिर सामने से कोई चलकर आया। सफ़ेद पगड़ी। लंबी लाठी।
lines.en: Then someone walked towards him. A white turban. A long staff.

lines.speaker: hamir
lines.text: कानजी… मेरे बेटे… चल, घर चलते हैं।
lines.en: Kanji… my son… come, let's go home.
lines.shot: a tall figure made of pale blue light shaped like a man in a turban with a staff, walking over white salt

lines.speaker: narrator
lines.text: बापू। बिल्कुल बापू जैसे। वही चाल, वही आवाज़।
lines.en: Baba. Exactly like Baba. The same walk, the same voice.

lines.speaker: narrator
lines.text: कानजी आगे बढ़ा… और रुक गया।
lines.en: Kanji stepped forward… and stopped.

lines.speaker: narrator
lines.text: नमक पर कानजी की परछाईं थी। पर बापू के पैरों के नीचे… कोई परछाईं नहीं थी।
lines.en: On the salt lay Kanji's shadow. But under Baba's feet… there was no shadow at all.
lines.shot: close-up of white cracked salt, a boy's shadow on it, and beside it a man's bare feet with no shadow

scenes.setting: the Great Rann of Kutch, an endless flat white salt desert, plain unmarked salt crust with natural hexagon cracks, moonless night, black sky full of stars, a boy with eyes shut tight, ears straining, blue light figure in front of him

lines.speaker: narrator
lines.text: कानजी ने आँखें बंद कर लीं। दादा की बात याद आई।
lines.en: Kanji shut his eyes. He remembered Dada's words.

lines.speaker: narrator
lines.text: हर आवाज़ झूठी हो सकती है। पीतल की नहीं।
lines.en: Every voice can lie. Brass cannot.

lines.speaker: hamir
lines.text: आँखें खोल, कानजी। अपने बापू को देख।
lines.en: Open your eyes, Kanji. Look at your father.
lines.shot: a glowing blue man-shaped light leaning over a small boy who keeps his eyes shut

lines.speaker: narrator
lines.text: उसने सुना। हवा। अपनी धड़कन। उस आवाज़ की फुसफुसाहट।
lines.en: He listened. The wind. His own heartbeat. The whisper of that voice.

lines.speaker: narrator
lines.text: और फिर… बहुत दूर, दाईं तरफ़ से… टन्न… टन्न।
lines.en: And then… very far away, from the right… clang… clang.

lines.speaker: narrator
lines.text: एक घंटी।
lines.en: A bell.

scenes.setting: the Great Rann of Kutch, an endless flat white salt desert, plain unmarked salt crust with natural hexagon cracks, moonless night, black sky full of stars, a boy running away from the blue lights towards the dark right side, holding his bell

lines.speaker: narrator
lines.text: कानजी ने रोशनी से मुँह फेरा और घंटी की आवाज़ की तरफ़ दौड़ा।
lines.en: Kanji turned away from the light and ran towards the sound of the bell.

lines.speaker: hamir
lines.text: कानजी! उधर मत जा! वहाँ अँधेरा है!
lines.en: Kanji! Don't go that way! It's dark there!
lines.shot: blue lights streaking after a running boy across dark salt

lines.speaker: narrator
lines.text: पीछे से बापू की आवाज़ चीख़ी। फिर माँ की। फिर दादा की। सब एक साथ।
lines.en: Behind him Baba's voice screamed. Then Ma's. Then Dada's. All at once.
lines.shot: a small boy running through darkness on salt, many blue lights chasing behind him

lines.speaker: narrator
lines.text: कानजी नहीं रुका। टन्न… टन्न… आवाज़ पास आती गई।
lines.en: Kanji didn't stop. Clang… clang… the sound grew closer.

scenes.setting: a deep crack in the salt crust of the Great Rann of Kutch, an endless flat white salt desert, plain unmarked salt crust with natural hexagon cracks at night, a black buffalo standing beside it, an injured man lying in the crack
scenes.continuity: Hamir, the father in a white turban, lies injured inside the salt crack; Kanji, the boy, stands at its edge; only one black buffalo

lines.speaker: narrator
lines.text: और वहाँ, नमक की एक गहरी दरार के किनारे… काली खड़ी थी। गले में घंटी।
lines.en: And there, at the edge of a deep crack in the salt… stood Kali. The bell on her neck.
lines.shot: a big black buffalo with curved horns standing at the edge of a crack in white salt at night

lines.speaker: narrator
lines.text: और दरार में, पैर पर कपड़ा बाँधे, पड़े थे… बापू।
lines.en: And in the crack, a cloth tied around his leg, lay… Baba.

lines.speaker: kanji
lines.text: बापू!
lines.en: Baba!

lines.speaker: hamir
lines.text: कानजी? तू… तू सच में है?
lines.en: Kanji? Are you… are you really here?

lines.speaker: hamir
lines.text: तीन रात से वो रोशनियाँ तेरी आवाज़ में मुझे बुला रही थीं।
lines.en: For three nights those lights have been calling me in your voice.

lines.speaker: hamir
lines.text: मैं नहीं गया। काली ने हिलने नहीं दिया। वो मुझे छोड़कर नहीं गई।
lines.en: I didn't go. Kali wouldn't let me move. She never left me.

scenes.setting: the salt crack in the Great Rann of Kutch, an endless flat white salt desert, plain unmarked salt crust with natural hexagon cracks at night, a boy helping his limping father up, blue lights gathering in a ring around them
scenes.continuity: Hamir, the father, limps with his staff; Kanji, the boy, supports him; only one black buffalo

lines.speaker: narrator
lines.text: कानजी ने बापू को सहारा देकर बाहर निकाला।
lines.en: Kanji helped his father climb out.

lines.speaker: narrator
lines.text: पर तब तक, चारों तरफ़ रोशनियाँ जमा हो चुकी थीं। एक घेरा।
lines.en: But by then the lights had gathered all around them. A ring.
lines.shot: a ring of glowing blue lights surrounding a boy, a limping man and a black buffalo on white salt

lines.speaker: hamir
lines.text: रोशनी को मत देखना, बेटा। आँखें ज़मीन पर। कान घंटी पर।
lines.en: Don't look at the light, son. Eyes on the ground. Ears on the bell.

lines.speaker: kanji
lines.text: और रास्ता?
lines.en: And the way?

lines.speaker: hamir
lines.text: काली जानती है। जानवर कभी झूठी आवाज़ के पीछे नहीं जाते।
lines.en: Kali knows it. Animals never follow a false voice.

scenes.setting: the Great Rann of Kutch, an endless flat white salt desert, plain unmarked salt crust with natural hexagon cracks at night, a boy ringing a brass bell, a limping man holding a buffalo's cord, walking with heads down while blue lights follow
scenes.continuity: the boy rings the brass bell as they walk

lines.speaker: narrator
lines.text: वो चल पड़े। आगे काली। पीछे बापू। बीच में कानजी, घंटी बजाते हुए।
lines.en: They set off. Kali in front. Baba behind. Kanji in the middle, ringing the bell.

lines.speaker: narrator
lines.text: टन्न… टन्न… हर क़दम पर।
lines.en: Clang… clang… with every step.
lines.shot: close-up of a small hand ringing a dented brass bell

lines.speaker: jeevi
lines.text: हमीर… रुक जाओ… मैं यहाँ हूँ, पीछे देखो…
lines.en: Hamir… stop… I'm here, look behind you…
lines.shot: pale blue lights following behind two walking figures and a buffalo on white salt

lines.speaker: raghu
lines.text: बेटा, ग़लत रास्ता है… इधर आओ…
lines.en: Son, it's the wrong way… come this way…
lines.shot: a blue light drifting close beside walking feet on cracked salt

lines.speaker: narrator
lines.text: रोशनियाँ पीछे-पीछे आती रहीं। हर उस आवाज़ में बोलती हुई, जिसे वो जानती थीं।
lines.en: The lights kept following. Speaking in every voice they knew.

scenes.setting: the Great Rann of Kutch, an endless flat white salt desert, plain unmarked salt crust with natural hexagon cracks at night, a boy and his father walking with eyes down, a blue light hovering right beside the boy's ear

lines.speaker: narrator
lines.text: और फिर एक आवाज़ आई जिसने बापू के क़दम रोक दिए।
lines.en: And then came a voice that stopped Baba in his tracks.

lines.speaker: kanji
lines.text: बापू… मैं यहाँ हूँ… पीछे… आपने मुझे छोड़ दिया…
lines.en: Baba… I'm here… behind you… you left me behind…
lines.shot: a pale blue light hovering behind a man's shoulder in the dark

lines.speaker: narrator
lines.text: कानजी की आवाज़। पीछे से। जबकि कानजी उनके हाथ को पकड़े खड़ा था।
lines.en: Kanji's voice. From behind. While Kanji stood right there, holding his hand.

lines.speaker: kanji
lines.en: Baba, that's not me! I'm here! Listen to the bell!

lines.speaker: narrator
lines.text: कानजी ने पूरी ताक़त से घंटी बजाई। टन्न! टन्न! टन्न!
lines.en: Kanji rang the bell with all his strength. Clang! Clang! Clang!

scenes.setting: the edge of a Maldhari herders' village of round white mud huts with conical thatched roofs in the Banni grasslands of Kutch, Gujarat at first light, a pale dawn over the Great Rann of Kutch, an endless flat white salt desert, plain unmarked salt crust with natural hexagon cracks, a woman and an old man running towards a boy, his limping father and a black buffalo

lines.speaker: narrator
lines.text: पूरब में आसमान फीका पड़ने लगा। रोशनियाँ एक-एक करके बुझ गईं।
lines.en: The sky in the east began to pale. The lights went out one by one.

lines.speaker: narrator
lines.text: और गाँव के किनारे, माँ और दादा ने देखा… रण से तीन परछाइयाँ लौट रही थीं।
lines.en: And at the village edge, Ma and Dada saw… three shadows returning from the Rann.
lines.shot: silhouettes of a boy, a limping man and a buffalo walking out of a white desert at dawn

lines.speaker: jeevi
lines.text: हमीर! कानजी!
lines.en: Hamir! Kanji!

lines.speaker: raghu
lines.text: पीतल ने झूठ नहीं बोला।
lines.en: The brass didn't lie.

lines.speaker: narrator
lines.text: उस सुबह बन्नी के एक भूंगे में बरसों बाद सब एक साथ हँसे।
lines.en: That morning, in one bhunga of Banni, everyone laughed together for the first time in years.

scenes.setting: inside the mud hut at night, a family asleep by a dying fire, a man waking up, a pale blue glow at the small window
scenes.continuity: the brass bell hangs on a nail by the boy's bed

lines.speaker: narrator
lines.text: उस रात सब थककर सो गए।
lines.en: That night everyone slept, exhausted.

lines.speaker: narrator
lines.text: आधी रात को खिड़की पर एक नीली चमक आई।
lines.en: At midnight, a blue glow appeared at the window.
lines.shot: a small round hut window with a pale blue glow outside in the dark

lines.speaker: kanji
lines.text: बापू… बापू, मैं बाहर हूँ… दरवाज़ा खोलो…
lines.en: Baba… Baba, I'm outside… open the door…
lines.shot: blue light leaking through the cracks of a wooden hut door at night

lines.speaker: narrator
lines.text: कानजी की आवाज़। बाहर से।
lines.en: Kanji's voice. From outside.

lines.speaker: narrator
lines.text: हमीर नींद में उठे। दरवाज़े की तरफ़ बढ़े। उनका हाथ कुंडी तक पहुँचा…
lines.en: Hamir rose, half asleep. He moved to the door. His hand reached the latch…
lines.shot: a man's hand reaching for a wooden door latch in a dark hut, blue light in the cracks

scenes.setting: inside the mud hut at night, a boy sitting up in bed ringing a brass bell, the blue glow at the window fading

lines.speaker: narrator
lines.text: तभी, अंदर से… टन्न।
lines.en: Then, from inside… clang.

lines.speaker: narrator
lines.text: कानजी अपने बिस्तर पर बैठा था। हाथ में घंटी।
lines.en: Kanji was sitting up in his bed. The bell in his hand.
lines.shot: a boy sitting up in bed in the dark, ringing a brass bell, looking straight at his father

lines.speaker: kanji
lines.en: Baba. I'm here.

lines.speaker: narrator
lines.text: बाहर की नीली रोशनी काँपी… और बुझ गई।
lines.en: The blue light outside trembled… and went out.

lines.speaker: narrator
lines.text: रण में आज भी अमावस की रातों को रोशनियाँ चलती हैं। वैज्ञानिक कहते हैं, शायद दलदल की गैस है।
lines.en: On moonless nights the lights still walk in the Rann. Scientists say it may be marsh gas.

lines.speaker: narrator
lines.text: पर बन्नी के हर घर में, आज भी, दरवाज़े के पास एक पीतल की घंटी टँगी रहती है।
lines.en: But in every home in Banni, even today, a brass bell hangs beside the door.
lines.shot: a dented brass bell hanging on a nail beside a mud hut door, a faint blue glow far outside

youtube.description:
In the Banni grasslands at the edge of the Great Rann of Kutch, herders tell of chir batti: lights that walk across the salt on moonless nights and call people by name, in the voices of those they have already taken. When his father disappears into the Rann chasing a lost buffalo, ten-year-old Kanji walks out into the white desert with nothing but a brass bell.

Chir batti is a real local legend of Kutch. The characters and events in this story are fiction.
